area: King's Pass, Dirtmouth and the Forgotten Crossroads (to False Knight and Vengeful Spirit; Greenpath's first two rooms and the Crystal Peak toll room as exits)
sources: mined: hallownest-calculator (betorzdev/hallownest-calculator, js/scene-objects.js, generated from the game files by its tools/extract-scenes.py): every scene's tile-map size, enemies per Hunter's-Journal type (count + group centre), breakable walls/floors, one-way walls, hidden-area masks, geo rocks, soul totems, chests, lore tablets

mined: hallownest-calculator js/map.js + js/map-walk.js (from the game's own Game_Map): each room's map drawing as ground/rock cells, and the box that maps scene coords onto it -> the 'map-envelope' solids (stylised: no interior platforms)
mined: RandomizerMod (homothetyhk) door table, room table and logic: exits, one-ways, gates (what each door needs)
mined: TangledMapView mapData.js (sirbrialliance): door, item and bench positions in each scene's own units
wiki: hollowknight.wiki enemy/boss pages (datamined HP, behaviour), Nail (5 damage), SOUL (11 per hit, 33 per cast), Focus pages
estimate: hidden-item descriptions, difficulty ratings, play minutes, hero box and jump height (marked per field)

units.how: HK renders 1 unit = 64 screen px at 1080p (camera at z -38.1, gameplay plane z 0, perspective FOV giving 16.875 u of height; 1920/64 = 30 u wide). So our 1920 px view = 30 u: 1 HK unit = 64 of our px.

hero.boxSrc: estimate: Knight BoxCollider2D ~0.5 x 1.28 u (community value), x64
hero.jumpSrc: estimate: full-hold jump ~5.2 u (not yet read from HeroController)
startAbilities: nail (old nail: 5 damage, ~0.41 s cooldown, horizontal, up and down slash; down-slash pogo off enemies/spikes)
focus (33 soul = heal 1 mask in ~1.14 s)
run, variable jump, fall-through nothing; no dash, no wall-climb, no double jump

abilityOrder.ability: Vengeful Spirit (ranged spell, 15 dmg, 33 soul; also opens the Elder Baldur gates)
abilityOrder.where: Ancestral Mound, from the Snail Shaman

abilityOrder.ability: Mothwing Cloak (dash) - next ability, outside this area
abilityOrder.where: Greenpath, after Hornet (reached through the Baldur gate at Crossroads_11_alt)

firstPlayMinutes.src: estimate: typical first play; full100 needs claw/dash/wings/lantern/Isma's tear/dream nail from later areas

notes: enemies: one entry per Hunter's-Journal type per room with count; 'at' is the group's centre when count > 1 (individual spots not in the mined data)
enemies with firstVisit false are the Infected-Crossroads variants (after Monarch Wings or a Dreamer); spawned true = hatchlings / Gruz Mother's brood

terrain 'solid' rectangles named map-envelope come from the game's own map drawing of each room (1-unit cells): outer walls, floors and ceilings of the cave; interior platforms, slopes and spikes are NOT in it
breakable/secretWall boxes: centre mined, size estimated
insets: Ancestral Mound, Black Egg Temple, Salubra's shop and Sly's hut are entered by background doors; they are drawn in a row below the map, not in place
boundary rooms (Greenpath x2, Crystal Peak toll) are drawn but excluded from the metrics
